title: C SOS: per-origin monotonic seq gate + per-origin rate limiter in sos_post
description: C slice of b7z9.121 (spec 18.4.1). lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c sos_post: (1) WIRE the per-origin monotonic Origin Sequence gate - the parsed origin_sig.origin_sequence is never compared against a per-origin last-seen table, so a stale-but-valid signed SOS replays. Add a small per-origin (keyed by origin IID, 8 bytes) last-seen uint64 table; accept only if origin_sequence strictly exceeds last-seen, update on accept. (2) Replace the single global s_sos_rl_state (coap_server.c:447, comment at :446 admits 'multi-source per-IID table is follow-up work') with a per-origin rate-limit table keyed by the same origin IID, so one chatty origin doesn't consume another's 3/hour budget. Both tables can share a bounded per-origin record array (seq + ratelimit state). Keep silent-drop (-ENOENT) semantics for all rejections per spec + sos_signature.json. Tests: extend lichen/tests/sos_ratelimit and/or a sos_post-level host test with two origins A and B - stale seq from A rejected while A's rate budget intact, and A's rate limiting must not suppress B. Landable independently of the AddrForKey slice.
close_reason: Implemented spec 18.4.1 per-origin SOS accounting in C sos_post. Replaced the single global sos_ratelimit_state with a bounded per-origin table (sos_origin_table.h, 16 slots, LRU eviction by oldest accepted-alert timestamp) keyed by origin node IID; wired the previously-absent per-origin monotonic Origin Sequence gate (accept only strictly-advancing seq). Two codereview-driven refinements: (a) explicit accepted flag closes the seq-0 replay gap (last_seq==0 alone can't distinguish 'no prior' from 'accepted 0'); (b) seq + budget committed only after lichen_coap_respond succeeds. Tests: new host unit lichen/tests/sos_origin_table (per-origin gate, seq-0 non-replay, per-origin rate isolation, LRU eviction, NULL safety) - ctest 1/1 PASS; Zephyr native_sim coap_config_put_auth builds+links clean. Header-only design shares impl between server and test; ratelimit init is memset(0) inline (no new sos_ratelimit.c link dep, bd a2a2 class). 3x delegated codereview (kimi-k3): correctness PASS, security PASS (finding 1 - node-IID extraction vs key-store derivation mismatch - is a real PRE-EXISTING issue filed separately as 3dpc, out of this slice's scope), edge PASS (2 P4: uptime-0 sentinel negligible, dead include - fixed). Commit 869c33dad8. Keyed by the same node_iid the surrounding code already uses; the key-derivation redesign is 3dpc + AddrForKey slice 121.2.
